name: Search Overlay
summary: Named modal search dialog with canonical dismissal, a labelled native search field, and optional target-owned result content.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Modal dialog and backdrop layer controlled by the target lifecycle.

anatomy.name: box
anatomy.description: Native search form panel with bounded viewport geometry and scroll partition.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Top row for the required visible title and canonical dismiss action.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible localized dialog title used by aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Required named dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Native label for the search input; targets may present it visually or with the shared visually-hidden utility.

anatomy.name: results
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned list, status, loading, empty, or error region.

anatomy.name: resultItem
anatomy.description: Native list item for a navigable result.

anatomy.name: result
anatomy.description: Native destination link for a result.

states.name: closed
states.description: Hidden overlay state unavailable to focus and assistive technology.

states.name: inputFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the primary query field.

states.name: resultFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a result destination.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The target synchronizes visual open state with accessible availability and removes or disables closed focusables.

behavior.name: dialogSemantics
behavior.description: When open, Search Overlay is a named modal dialog with a required visible title.

behavior.name: searchForm
behavior.description: A native labelled search control drives the target-owned search request and submission policy.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Opening moves focus to the query field, modal focus remains contained, and closing restores focus logically.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The target closes on Escape and provides a visible named canonical dismiss action; backdrop dismissal remains target policy.

behavior.name: queryOwnership
behavior.description: A target may own query as controlled state or initialize native uncontrolled state, but must maintain one authoritative value and preserve form submission semantics.

behavior.name: resultNavigation
behavior.description: Ordinary linked results use native list and link semantics; combobox or listbox interaction is not implied.

behavior.name: resultStatusOwnership
behavior.description: The target owns truthful loading, empty, error, count, and live-announcement policy; the base component does not create an unconditional live region.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible localized dialog title used for the modal accessible name.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual accessible name for the canonical dismiss action.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls visible and accessible presentation while the target owns trigger, inertness, focus, dismissal, scroll locking, and lifecycle.

properties.name: inputLabel
properties.description: Localized native label for the search query; placeholder text is not a substitute.

properties.name: query
properties.description: Current query when the target uses controlled state, or initial value when it intentionally uses native uncontrolled state.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Optional supplemental hint displayed while query is empty.

properties.name: results
properties.description: Target-owned result list, status, loading, empty, or error content.

accessibility: Expose a visible title and named modal dialog only while the target actually blocks background interaction.
Move focus to the native search field, contain Tab and Shift+Tab, close on Escape, and restore focus logically.
Compose the required named dismiss action with canonical Close Button.
Use a native label and type=search control; placeholder does not replace the label.
Use ordinary list and link semantics for results unless an accepted combobox contract is deliberately composed.
Announce dynamic status only from truthful target-owned content and avoid unconditional live-region noise.
Preserve bounded viewport geometry, keyboard focus visibility, reduced motion, and forced-colors boundaries.

web.notes: Canonical modal/search anatomy, bounded panel layout, native result list presentation, and interaction states are implemented; the shared docs target demonstrates the lifecycle.

shopify.notes: Liquid can expose the semantic form and result container, but predictive-search service, truthful status, focus containment, Escape, inertness, and restoration still require target runtime.
